headline: Delta flights in Atlanta delayed by weight system outage
pages: Delta flights in and out of Atlanta faced significant delays on Sunday because of a problem with the system that calculates a plane's weight and balance. Hartsfield-Jackson is Delta's largest hub and one of the busiest airports in the world. The system tallies the airframe, fuel, passengers and baggage, and helps pilots find the center of gravity. Delta said teams were using manual workarounds to get flights out safely while work continued to restore automation. Only Delta was affected at the time, but continued delays could spill over to other airlines and airports. The outage came one week after an FAA outage caused a nationwide ground stop and thousands of canceled flights.
